description: April 29 birthday meaning: Taurus decan 1, birthday number 11, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an April 29 birthday falls in Taurus, in the first decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 11. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Taurus is fixed and earth.

sections.heading: April 29 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Master number 11 stays intact on April 29, bringing intuition and inspiration to early Taurus, about eight degrees into the sign. Venus's rule of sign and decan grounds the vision in the senses. Traditionally this is read as an intuitive artist or maker, someone who knows by feel when a piece of work is finally right.

On April 29 the Sun usually sits at about 8° Taurus, in the first decan, where Venus rules the decan as well as the sign. With Venus as both ruler and sub-ruler, the first decan of Taurus is traditionally seen as the sign at its most sensuous and steady. Birthdays from about April 20 to April 30 land here. The emphasis is on comfort that has been earned: texture, taste, music and the slow pleasure of things done well. This doubled Venus tone is often linked with loyalty and a calm, grounding presence that friends lean on. It can also make change feel like an imposition rather than an invitation. Those born in this decan tend to flourish when they treat flexibility as another form of care, not a threat to it.

sections.heading: April 29 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 29th, your compound is 2 + 9 = 11, and because 11 is a master number it is kept as 11 rather than reduced to 2. The 2 brings sensitivity, the 9 brings compassion and breadth, and together they create one of the most intuitive birthday numbers. People born on the 29th are often described as emotionally perceptive, idealistic and capable of inspiring others. Their feelings can run high, with marked highs and lows. As a secondary number, the 29 tends to reward creative and caring outlets for that intensity, and rest between them.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one April 29 birthday to the next: it is 22 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22.

sections.heading: Born on April 29: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 29 is the 119th day of the year (120th in a leap year). By May 21, 22 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Gemini.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by April 29, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on April 29 include Hirohito (1901), Anggun (1974) and Henri Poincaré (1854).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 29?
faq.answer: April 29 is Taurus in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Taurus, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 29?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 29 the Life Path is 22 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 11 for everyone born on the 29th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 29?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for an April 29 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 29?
faq.answer: April 29 is also the birthday of Hirohito (1901), Anggun (1974) and Henri Poincaré (1854). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
